title: atrium embed fails on a fresh machine: onnxruntime rejects model_quantized.onnx_data from the Hugging Face cache
notes: Found 2026-11-23 installing a fresh instance on a second macOS machine (Darwin 27.2, uv 0.11, pnpm 11) following syntopica AGENTS.md.

onnxruntime 1.31.0 + huggingface-hub 2.2.0: 'External data path validation failed for initializer model.embed_tokens.weight_quantized ... External data path escapes model directory'. cached_model_file returns the snapshot symlink; onnxruntime resolves it to blobs/ and the .onnx_data sibling resolves to a different blob path, so it refuses to load. Machines whose cache predates these versions are unaffected, which hides it.

Workaround in use: replace the two symlinks in snapshots/<rev>/onnx/ with real copies. Fix options: hf_hub_download(local_dir=...) into an atrium-owned model dir, or copy both files into one dir before InferenceSession.
done_when: atrium embed succeeds on an empty HF cache with current onnxruntime/huggingface-hub; a test covers the symlinked-cache layout
result: atrium embed fails on a fresh machine: onnxruntime rejects model_quantized.onnx_data from the Hugging Face cache
evidence: Reproduced with an empty HF_HOME (onnxruntime 1.31.0, huggingface-hub 2.2.0): External data path escapes model directory. materialized_model_file replaces the two snapshot symlinks with hard links; the same empty-cache run then returned a (1, 384) vector. tests/test_materialized_model_file.py covers the symlinked layout; pytest 868 passed.
